: ${DB_PASSWORD:="password"}

  "db_host": "${DB_HOST}",
  "db_port": "${DB_PORT}",

  "db_user": "${DB_USER}",
  "db_type": "${DB_TYPE}",

  -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${MONITORING_TOKEN:-unauthenticated}" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \
